description: 7-email nurture sequence for MIFECO SaaS leads. Covers all 3 products: Project Hypatia Pro, PM Accelerator, VibraEngineer. Uses {{name}}, {{company}}, {{product}} placeholders.

email_sequences.subject: Welcome to MIFECO SaaS, {{name}}! Here's what we build
email_sequences.body_template:
Hi {{name}},

Thanks for your interest in MIFECO's SaaS tools! We build purpose-built software for engineering and project teams — not generic platforms, but focused solutions that solve real problems.

Here's a quick overview of what we offer:

🚀 **Project Hypatia Pro**
AI-powered project management designed for engineering teams. Hypothesis-driven workflows, automated risk tracking, and intelligent resource allocation. Built for teams that need more than a to-do list.

⚡ **PM Accelerator**
A lightweight project management acceleration toolkit. Get teams up and running fast with templates, automated reporting, and simplified workflows. Perfect for teams transitioning from spreadsheets to structured project management.

🔧 **VibraEngineer**
Specialized engineering vibration analysis and monitoring platform. Collect, analyze, and visualize vibration data from sensors and field measurements. Purpose-built for mechanical, civil, and aerospace engineers.

Which of these sounds most relevant to your work at {{company}}? Hit reply and let me know — I can tailor the rest of these emails to your specific needs.

Best,
The MIFECO Team

email_sequences.subject: {{name}}, see Project Hypatia Pro in 2 minutes
email_sequences.body_template:
Hi {{name}},

If you're managing complex engineering projects, this is for you.

**Project Hypatia Pro** helps teams like yours:

email_sequences.subject: {{name}}, PM Accelerator — from spreadsheets to structure
email_sequences.body_template:
Hi {{name}},

Not every team needs a full enterprise PMO tool. Sometimes you just need the right structure, fast.

**PM Accelerator** is our answer to that. It's designed for teams who are outgrowing spreadsheets but aren't ready for a heavy project management overhaul:

📁 **Template Library** — Start with pre-built project templates for software, engineering, construction, and product launches. Customize in minutes.

📈 **Automated Reporting** — Generate stakeholder reports, sprint summaries, and burndown charts with one click. No more copy-pasting into PowerPoint.

⏱️ **Time Tracking Light** — Simple, non-intrusive time tracking that actually gets adopted by your team. See where hours are going without the friction of enterprise time systems.

🤝 **Team Collaboration** — Built-in task assignments, comment threads, and file sharing. Everything your team needs in one place.

PM Accelerator is available as a standalone product or as an add-on to Project Hypatia Pro.

👉 [Explore PM Accelerator](https://accelerator.mifeco.com)

Best,
The MIFECO Team

email_sequences.subject: VibraEngineer — purpose-built for mechanical & civil engineers
email_sequences.body_template:
Hi {{name}},

If you work with rotating machinery, structural dynamics, or field vibration measurements, this one's for you.

**VibraEngineer** is the only SaaS platform built specifically for engineering vibration analysis:

📡 **Multi-Source Data Ingestion** — Pull data from field sensors, accelerometers, FFT analyzers, and simulation outputs. CSV, JSON, or API — we speak all formats.

📉 **Frequency Domain Analysis** — Automated FFT, PSD, spectrograms, and order tracking. No more wrestling with MATLAB scripts for basic analysis.

🔍 **Anomaly Detection** — ML-powered pattern recognition flags unusual vibration signatures. Early warning for bearing wear, imbalance, misalignment, and resonance.

📋 **Report Generation** — Export professional vibration analysis reports with your branding. Ready for client delivery or regulatory submission.

See it in action:
👉 [VibraEngineer Demo](https://vibraengineer.mifeco.com/demo)

Have a specific data set you'd like us to analyze? Reply and upload it — we'll run a free sample analysis.

Best,
The MIFECO Team
